prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Choose Your Desktop Companion", "Select a friend to bring to life on your desktop.", "Starter Pet Options"]
1: ["Find Your Pet in the System Tray", "Your pet lives on your desktop and system tray. Right-click the icon anytime to open controls or hide the app.", "Got It!"]
2: ["Summoning Your Desktop Pet...", "We are preparing your pet's animations and desktop behaviors.", "Tip: Right-click your pet to toggle visibility or access settings."]
3: ["Upload Photo or Pick a Template", "Upload a clear photo to generate your custom pet, or pick one of our ready-made styles.", "Upload Custom Photo", "Use Preset Style Instead"]
4: ["Select Your Adoption Journey", "Swipe or click arrow keys to explore paths."]
5: ["Name your companion to officially finalize adoption."]
6: ["We will send a desktop notification when your pet is ready!"]
7: ["Quick shortcut: Double-click pet to talk, right-click for main menu.", "Your pet is active! Double-click to interact or right-click to manage settings."]
8: ["Save & Sync Your Desktop Pet", "Sign in to keep your pet safely saved to your account so you never lose progress when re-logging.", "Existing pets automatically restore upon sign-in."]
9: ["Secure Your Pet Account", "Continue with Account (Restores Pets)", "Your pet data is linked directly to your account credentials."]
